notes.title: Step into the Light Update | v0.7.1
notes.content:
Happy Holidays, survivors, 

A new update is here in the house, and just in time for Christmas. This update brings you a new present that should help you survive the horrors of the house. 

New Items

 The Breaker Box. Use this box to help scare away the monsters in the house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/f31b43c5b97ada94159ec21f8d3187ba4b500043.png

 Added analytics to help when deciding what needs to be improved and what needs to be reworked. The link to our privacy policy is Our Privacy Policy.

 Patched a few bugs and made some general improvements.



That's all for us for now, but stay tuned. January is bringing something big to level 2, and you'll definitely get lost in all of the twists and turns.

notes.title: From the Darkness Update | v0.7.0
notes.content:
Hello again, survivors,

We know it's been a while, but there is finally some new content in The House. Introducing The 2nd Level. This level is still being worked on, so there may be some bugs to iron out and plenty of new areas still being developed to make this level rival the original in difficulty and size. Below is what you can expect in this new update.

NEW FEATURES

A new level. Search through the container yard to find a way to escape.

A new enemy. Something is lurking in the darkness. If you hear the roar, it's already too late. 

ACHIEVEMENTS!!! Brand new achievements to unlock as you progress through the container yard. 

Fixed a lot of bugs and made some major performance improvements.


That's all this time. Check back for next months update for a new area to level 2 just in time to ring in Christmas.

notes.title: The House v0.6.1: The save for saving
notes.content:
Good evening, survivors. 

We're bringing a small patch to the house that should fix the bug with the save system causing the game to crash after the new update. 


Added default values to the save system to work around the update adding new items to load.


That's all for us for today. Happy surviving.

-HalfLabs Studio

notes.title: Outdoorsy Update | v0.6.0
notes.content:
Hello again, survivors,

Today we bring another update to The House, the Outdoorsy Update. *Warning: You will need to start a new game to avoid breaking the save system and to earn the achievements. We're working on a fix for this, but do not have it ready yet.*

NEW FEATURES

The Outdoors. Explore a whole new area and solve the puzzle to escape the house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/ba50cb18ab99446ad27fb0af6b2ad1e55db04997.png

ACHIEVEMENTS!!! We've been thinking about this for a long time, and they're finally here. Unlock 15 different achievements in The House, with more coming as we add more features.

Fixed a few bugs and made some improvements.


That's all for us this time. Stay tuned for next month's update, coming April 20.

notes.title: Coward Update | v0.5.0
notes.content:
Hello survivors,

Welcome to the newest update of The House. This one brings a new way to survive The House and a new feature.


A hiding system!!! Now you can finally hide from the monsters that roam the house.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/602ce8fb78b5b3945eb963fd80d704ea899925a6.jpg

A brand new feature: Saving!!! Now you can save and load your progress in The House

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/15bfe70d03fa3b50c895be2302039fc8e8f966a0.jpg

 Added a new hints to the keypads to make them less confusing.


Make sure to stay tuned for the next headliner update coming February 20. It'll bring some new ways to help you stay alive in the house.

notes.title: Little Minions Update | v0.4.0
notes.content:
Hello survivors,

The first update of 2022 brings a couple of new things.


The Gremlin!!! The newest enemy to The House. You'll have to be careful when going through the 2nd floor now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/a7d383a8293dfa0f867a301f6392ac06121386fc.jpg

Updated the pause menu. Now you can give feedback directly from the pause menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/0494bc41ff7de40d313b1cffcedd9738eb27598a.jpg

 Minor bug fixes.


Make sure to stay tuned for the next headliner update coming February 20. It'll bring some new ways to help you stay alive in the house.

notes.title: The House V0.3.1
notes.content:
Hello Players and Happy New Year. 

Today we're bringing some bug fixes to The House.


 Fixed the ambient lighting so everything is dark again.
 Nerfed the enemy movement so the player doesn't get stuck in the basement area.
 Added meshes to the Christmas items so you can't walk through them.
 Fixed the Main Instructions Menu so it's now centered on the screen.


Be sure to keep on the lookout for our newest headliner update hitting The House on January 20th. Until then, Good luck and have fun.

notes.title: Creepy Basement Update | v0.3.0
notes.content:
Merry Christmas, survivors,

Our final major update of the years brings a lot of changes to The House.

Added

 New Area!!! The basement. Explore a whole new section of the house and find the new key that will unlock the front door.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/f52775ea8c38884e6fce9bcffc1ac224b30ea33d.jpg
Christmas decorations!!! Celebrate the season with some Christmas decorations spread throughout the house.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41313569/644e82c7b918e558633e8857f98fcbfa2e4cef6d.jpg



Fixed

Reworked the flashlight to remove the yellow coloring.

Redesigned some of the keypads to make them less confusing.



That's all for us for this year. Stay tuned for the next update coming in January that should help you survive a little easier.

Happy Holidays and good luck.

notes.title: Creepy Attic Update | v0.2.0
notes.content:
Hello friends,

Our first major update is here!!! This update features a new area to explore with a new challenge to stop you from getting out.
